name: Osaki
tagline: Shibuya in 8 minutes and Shinjuku in 13 minutes. Served by 4 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥110,000 to ¥120,000.
summary: The station is in Shinagawa City, served by JR Yamanote Line, JR Saikyo Line, JR Shonan-Shinjuku Line and Rinkai Line. Journey times to the main business districts are 28 minutes to Otemachi, 13 minutes to Shinjuku, 8 minutes to Shibuya and 13 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥110,000 to ¥120,000. The station stands 3.7 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 16.9 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 3.7 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 3.7 m to 20.6 m, a difference of 16.9 m. These figures were read from the elevation API of the Geospatial Information Authority of Japan at nine points: the station itself and eight compass directions 400 m out.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of 0.5 to 3 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 6 fall inside the area, and the deepest projection among them is 0.5 to 3 m. For storm surge, 6 of the nine points also fall inside the projected area. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.

groceries.name: まいばすけっと 大崎駅前店

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 6 clinics and 9 pharmacies. Facilities recorded as hospitals lie at サザンガーデンクリニック, about 516 m away and 有仁会阿部病院, about 826 m away. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 4 lines serve the station: JR Yamanote Line, JR Saikyo Line, JR Shonan-Shinjuku Line and Rinkai Line. The lines are split between operators (JR East runs 3 lines and Tokyo Waterfront Area Rapid Transit runs 1 line), so when one line stops you can change to a line run by a different company. Scored out of 100 from the number of lines and the spread of operators, transfer convenience here comes to 85.

rentRange.note: One room ¥110,000 to ¥120,000, 1K ¥110,000 to ¥120,000, 1LDK ¥200,000 to ¥210,000 and 2LDK ¥300,000 to ¥310,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥110,000 to ¥120,000. For 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.note: 616 m away in a straight line. It reaches Otemachi in about the same time as Osaki. One-room rents run about ¥10,000 higher.
808 m away in a straight line. It reaches Otemachi 5 minutes sooner than Osaki. One-room rents run about ¥13,000 higher.

noiseSources: The 首都高速中央環状線 viaduct runs 117 m away. It is an expressway, so traffic is audible day and night
山手通り (2 lanes each way) runs 36 m away. Morning and evening, the cars are audible indoors

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 7 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 2 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: Among the 23 wards' stations, comparatively few of the points around this one fall inside the projected inundation area for the largest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: 2 lines serve the station, and the choice of connections is wider than at most stations in the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are among the lowest in the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is on the high side for the 23 wards.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make: 首都高速中央環状線 runs 117 m away.
